$$\sup_x |F_n(x) - \Phi(x)| \le \frac{C_0\,\sum_{k=1}^n E|k\epsilon_k|^3}{\sigma_n^3},$$

$$\varepsilon_n := \sup_x |F_n(x)-\Phi(x)| \le \frac{C_0\cdot n^4/4}{n^{9/2}/(3\sqrt{3})} = O(n^{-1/2}) \to 0.$$

$$P(S_n = 0) \le O(n^{-3/2}) + O(n^{-1/2}) = O(n^{-1/2}) \to 0.$$

Therefore:

$$I_n = 2\pi \, P(S_n = 0) \leq 2\pi \cdot O(n^{-1/2}) \to 0$$
